evals.prompt: I want to go to Atlanta for TABConf this year. Find me flights, I'm flexible by a day or two on each side. 1 adult, economy.
evals.expected_output: Looks up TABConf dates, assumes the origin airport from memory or geolocation (states it), searches Google Flights, shows a date grid around the conference and a table of the best itineraries with price, airline, times and layovers, recommends one, and asks the user which to book and how to pay.
expectations: The reply states the conference dates and venue found by web search
The reply states which origin airport was assumed and why
The reply contains a table of itineraries with price, airline, departure/arrival times and layover
The reply contains a nearby-dates price comparison (grid or table)
The reply names who sells the cheapest fare (airline direct or OTA)
The reply ends by asking the user to choose an itinerary and payment mode rather than buying

evals.prompt: how much is a round trip ASU to MIA leaving nov 3 and coming back nov 10? just the top few options and whether it's cheaper a day either side
evals.expected_output: Uses gf.sh search and grid for ASU-MIA 2026-11-03/2026-11-10, presents 3-5 itineraries and a small date grid with a one-line verdict on shifting dates.
expectations: The reply lists at least three itineraries with prices and airlines
The reply includes prices for departure or return dates one day earlier and later
Prices are labelled as per-adult round-trip totals in USD

evals.prompt: Book me the cheapest Copa flight to Panama City for Dec 12-19. Use my usual airport.
evals.expected_output: Searches Google Flights from the remembered home airport, identifies the Copa itineraries and their fare families, recommends one, confirms the choice with the user, then invokes the copa-booking skill to carry out the booking.
expectations: The search uses the origin airport recorded in memory
The reply distinguishes Copa Economy Basic (no checked bag) from Economy Classic
The user is asked to confirm the itinerary before any booking step
The copa-booking skill is invoked (or named as the next step) rather than driving copaair.com ad hoc
